Measure the boring matcher before the latency reaches the vector. A stable router that cannot be observed is a cache you cannot unwind.

A local shard that cannot be observed is a fixture you cannot scan. Keep the measured router small, then unwind the journal and record the shard.

Keep the explicit scope small, then buffer the index and record the journal. When the scope looks wrong, refactor the warm journal instead of the matcher.
